title: 溪洛渡水壩~Xiluodu Dam
focus: 高拱壩與發電機額定量的辨識~High arch dam and generator rating interpretation
summary: 溪洛渡案例從發電機視在功率與實功區分開始，接續冷卻、轉速、轉矩與振動，再回到拱壩變形、水力消能及梯級調度。學員須追蹤每筆資料的量測邊界，說明同一數值在設備銘牌、瞬時測試和年度電量中具有不同意義，避免由規模推定性能。~The Xiluodu case starts by distinguishing apparent and active generator power, then studies cooling, speed, torque and vibration before returning to arch deformation, dissipation and cascade scheduling. Learners track measurement boundaries and explain why a number on a rating plate, during a test and in annual energy accounting means different things.
history: 供應商技術介紹記錄溪洛渡於二〇一四年六月全廠併網，並列十八部機組及十三點八六吉瓦名目裝機。文中單部發電機的八百五十五點六兆伏安是視在功率，不能當成相同數字的兆瓦。課程保留此單位辨識重點，不重複未獨立核對的減碳估算或世界排名。新增算例的功率因數與水力參數均為假設，歷史文獻年代及教材覆核日期亦與工程投產事件分開。~The supplier technical account records full Xiluodu grid connection in June 2014, eighteen units and 13.86 GW nominal installed capacity. Its 855.6 MVA generator figure is apparent power and cannot be relabeled as the same number of megawatts. The course retains that unit distinction without repeating unverified emissions estimates or world rankings. Power factors and hydraulic values in the new examples are assumptions, and literature dates and curriculum review remain separate from commissioning events.
example: 以下為本課原創情境串接，所有數值是假設，不能視為業主設計圖或操作許可。先完成「視在容量與無功」的守恆與邊界檢核，再比較「轉子旋轉儲能」及「風機轉速與耗能」的不同控制量。第一組計算為 S=800 MVA; P=640 MW; Qreactive=(S*S-P*P)**0.5=480 Mvar；第二組為 J=40000000 kg*m2; n=125 rpm; E=0.5*J*(2*pi*n/60)**2/1e9=3.426945973 GJ。學員須保留量綱、資料時間與量測位置，討論誤差如何傳到結果，將第三單元的限制寫入同一張決策表。任何未納入的結構、河道或機組耦合都列為下一階段工作，不由單一得數推論全工程安全。~This original sequence connects the first three units using assumed inputs; none is an owner drawing or an operating authorization. First establish conservation and boundaries for Apparent capacity and reactive power, then compare the controlling variables in Rotor rotational stored energy and Fan speed and power. The first calculation is S=800 MVA; P=640 MW; Qreactive=(S*S-P*P)**0.5=480 Mvar; the second is J=40000000 kg*m2; n=125 rpm; E=0.5*J*(2*pi*n/60)**2/1e9=3.426945973 GJ. Preserve dimensions, observation times, and measurement locations in the working sheet. Explain how input uncertainty changes each conclusion and include the third unit limitations in the same decision table. Structural, river, and machine interactions omitted by a model remain subsequent work; a single numerical answer cannot demonstrate safety of the complete project.

units.anchor: 視在容量與無功~Apparent capacity and reactive power
units.title: 視在容量與無功~Apparent capacity and reactive power
units.mechanism: 溪洛渡供應商資料中的兆伏安額定值提醒學員，發電機電流容量同時支援實功與無功。功率三角形以平方和關聯三者，不能把視在功率減實功當無功。教材只在平衡正弦穩態下求尺度，實際勵磁、定子電流及端部發熱限制需要能力曲線。 功率三角形的無功大小仍需配合符號慣例，供應與吸收可有相同幅值，卻對電壓控制造成不同作用。~The supplier MVA rating illustrates that generator current capacity supports both active and reactive power. Their power triangle uses a sum of squares; reactive power is not apparent power minus active power. The calculation applies to balanced sinusoidal steady state, while excitation, stator current and end-region heating require an actual capability curve. Reactive magnitude from the triangle still needs a sign convention; supply and absorption can share magnitude while having different consequences for voltage control at the connection.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：S=800 MVA; P=640 MW; Qreactive=(S*S-P*P)**0.5=480 Mvar。模型邊界：平衡正弦條件的功率三角形，未區分超前滯後無功符號。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: S=800 MVA; P=640 MW; Qreactive=(S*S-P*P)**0.5=480 Mvar. Model boundary: power triangle under balanced sinusoidal conditions, without assigning leading or lagging reactive sign.
units.verify: 核對功率表的無功正負定義與三相電流，再把實功無功工作點放到設備能力圖上。若低實功時電流仍高，應檢查無功輸出與諧波，而不能只憑發電兆瓦較低判斷設備熱負擔較低。~Check the meter reactive-sign convention and phase currents, then place active-reactive operating points on the machine capability diagram. High current at low active power calls for checking reactive output and harmonics rather than assuming that lower generated megawatts imply lower thermal loading.
units.failure: 以視在減實功估算無功會破壞向量關係，造成錯誤容量判斷；若系統含顯著諧波，簡單三角形本身也可能不足，需明確區分基波及總功率定義。~Subtracting active from apparent power violates the vector relationship and misstates capacity. Significant harmonics can also make the simple triangle inadequate, requiring explicit distinction between fundamental-frequency and total-power definitions before interpreting the result.
units.misconception: 無功等於視在功率直接減去實功~Reactive power equals apparent power minus active power.
units.practice: 固定視在容量並增加實功，計算剩餘無功尺度，畫出兩個工作點，再說明為何真正可用無功仍可能受勵磁或冷卻限制。~Increase active power at fixed apparent capacity and calculate the remaining reactive scale. Plot both operating points and explain why actual reactive capability may still be constrained by excitation or cooling.

units.anchor: 轉子旋轉儲能~Rotor rotational stored energy
units.title: 轉子旋轉儲能~Rotor rotational stored energy
units.mechanism: 水輪發電機轉子儲存的旋轉動能可在短時間功率不平衡時交換，但不是可持續供電的水庫能量。轉動慣量乘角速度平方的一半給出動能，若轉速變化小，能量變化仍與初始速度有關。教材用整體等效慣量建立尺度，不推定實際機組慣量常數。 可釋放動能是兩個轉速狀態的能量差，若只用總動能估算支援時間，就等於假設轉子可停轉。~Rotor kinetic energy can exchange during brief power imbalance but is not sustained reservoir generation. Half the inertia times angular speed squared gives stored energy, with small energy changes still dependent on initial speed. An assumed equivalent inertia establishes scale without claiming the actual machine inertia constant or allowable speed excursion. Available kinetic release is the energy difference between two speeds; using total stored energy for support duration implicitly assumes that the rotor can stop completely.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：J=40000000 kg*m2; n=125 rpm; E=0.5*J*(2*pi*n/60)**2/1e9=3.426945973 GJ。模型邊界：剛性等效轉子且慣量固定，未計水柱動能與控制作用。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: J=40000000 kg*m2; n=125 rpm; E=0.5*J*(2*pi*n/60)**2/1e9=3.426945973 GJ. Model boundary: rigid equivalent rotor with fixed inertia, excluding water-column energy and controls.
units.verify: 查慣量定義及是否包含水輪機與發電機全部旋轉件，將轉速變化與瞬時功率不平衡積分比較。若動能差不閉合，應查水力轉矩、控制延遲及損失，不任意調慣量使每次事件都符合。~Check which rotating components the inertia includes and compare speed change with integrated instantaneous power imbalance. If kinetic-energy change does not close, investigate hydraulic torque, control delay and losses rather than retuning inertia separately to fit every event recorded by the system.
units.failure: 把轉子總動能全當成可用支援，會忽略允許轉速範圍；柔性軸系還可能把能量分配到扭振模態，使平均轉速不足以描述局部動態。~Treating all rotor kinetic energy as available support ignores the permitted speed range. A flexible shaft can also distribute energy into torsional modes, making mean rotational speed insufficient to describe local dynamics during an electrical or hydraulic disturbance.
units.misconception: 轉子全部動能都可在不改變轉速下輸出~All rotor kinetic energy can be delivered without changing rotational speed.
units.practice: 將轉速降低百分之一，計算可釋出的動能而非總動能，再除以假想功率缺口估算短時尺度，列出此估算忽略的控制作用。~Reduce speed by one percent and calculate released rather than total kinetic energy. Divide it by an assumed power deficit to estimate a short time scale and list the control actions omitted by that estimate.

units.anchor: 風機轉速與耗能~Fan speed and power
units.title: 風機轉速與耗能~Fan speed and power
units.mechanism: 發電機通風增加時，風機相似律可估算相同幾何及相似工況下的流量、壓升和軸功率變化。功率對轉速約呈三次方，因此小幅提速可能增加顯著輔機耗能。相似律需配合系統阻力曲線，風道變更、失速或密度改變都可能破壞簡化比例。 風機功率相似通常指軸端，變頻器與馬達損失要另列，才能與電端輔機耗電建立一致比較。~Fan affinity laws estimate changes in flow, pressure and shaft power for unchanged geometry and similar conditions. Power varies approximately with the cube of speed, so a modest increase can raise auxiliary demand substantially. System resistance must also be considered; duct changes, stall and density variation can invalidate the simplified ratio. Fan power similarity usually refers to shaft power; converter and motor losses need separate terms before comparison with electrical auxiliary demand is physically consistent.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：P1=1 MW; ratioN=1.10 (dimensionless); P2=P1*ratioN**3=1.331 MW。模型邊界：同幾何同密度且效率近似固定的相似工作點，非任意風道工況。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: P1=1 MW; ratioN=1.10 (dimensionless); P2=P1*ratioN**3=1.331 MW. Model boundary: similar operating points with unchanged geometry, density and approximate efficiency, not arbitrary duct conditions.
units.verify: 同時量測風機轉速、壓差、有效風量及電功率，將工作點放到風機與系統曲線交會處。若提速後壓差升高但風量變化很小，應查阻塞或工作區域，不能只靠三次方律推定冷卻改善。~Measure speed, pressure difference, effective airflow and electrical power together, locating the operating point on fan and system curves. If speed raises pressure with little added flow, investigate obstruction or operating region rather than inferring improved cooling solely from the affinity-law estimate.
units.failure: 在失速區增加轉速可能提高噪音與耗能卻不改善均勻通風；若馬達效率隨負載變化，軸功率相似也不會直接等於電端功率比例，需要分別量測。~Increasing speed in a stalled region can raise noise and demand without improving uniform ventilation. Changing motor efficiency also means shaft-power similarity does not directly establish the electrical-input ratio, which requires a separate measurement boundary.
units.misconception: 風機轉速增加一成只會增加一成耗能~A ten-percent fan speed increase causes only a ten-percent power increase.
units.practice: 對三種轉速比例計算功率及理想風量比例，畫出耗能增幅，並指出若系統阻力增加時需要重新量測哪個工作點。~Calculate power and ideal airflow ratios for three speed ratios and plot the demand increase. Identify the operating point that must be remeasured if system resistance changes after maintenance or duct modification.

units.anchor: 定子銅損邊界~Stator copper loss boundary
units.title: 定子銅損邊界~Stator copper loss boundary
units.mechanism: 定子繞組的電阻損失與電流平方成正比，且電阻會隨溫度上升。教材以每相有效電阻與相電流計算三相損失，必須先辨認接法及所給電流定義。交流附加損失、鐵損與機械損失不在此式中，不能將三相銅損誤當成發電機全部損失。 每相有效電阻需和電流頻率及溫度相符，直流電阻只提供部分基礎，不能自動涵蓋所有交流附加效應。~Stator resistive loss scales with current squared and resistance increases with temperature. Calculate three-phase loss using effective per-phase resistance and phase current, first identifying winding connection and current definition. Additional AC, iron and mechanical losses remain outside this equation, so copper loss is not the entire generator loss account. Effective per-phase resistance must match temperature and frequency; a DC resistance measurement supplies only part of the basis and does not automatically include all AC effects.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Iphase=24000 A; Rphase=0.0007 ohm; Pcu=3*Iphase*Iphase*Rphase/1e6=1.2096 MW。模型邊界：三相相同相電流與每相運轉溫度電阻，未含其他損失。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Iphase=24000 A; Rphase=0.0007 ohm; Pcu=3*Iphase*Iphase*Rphase/1e6=1.2096 MW. Model boundary: equal phase currents and per-phase resistance at operating temperature, excluding other losses.
units.verify: 量測繞組電阻時記錄溫度並轉換到比較條件，核對相電流及接線方式，再將銅損估算與冷卻熱量比較。若總熱量高於銅損，應補列鐵損及其他熱源，而非把差額全歸於電阻量錯。~Record winding temperature during resistance measurement and convert to comparable conditions, checking phase current and connection. Compare copper-loss estimates with cooling heat. Heat greater than calculated copper loss requires other loss terms rather than assigning the entire difference to an incorrect resistance measurement.
units.failure: 用冷態電阻計算熱態損失會偏低，將線電流直接套到不相容接法也會造成比例錯誤；局部接頭高電阻可能集中發熱，平均每相值不能排除熱點。~Cold resistance understates hot-state loss, and using line current with an incompatible winding connection creates another ratio error. A high-resistance local joint can concentrate heat even when the mean per-phase value appears reasonable for the winding as a whole.
units.misconception: 三相銅損就是發電機全部能量損失~Three-phase copper loss is the complete energy loss of the generator.
units.practice: 固定電阻把電流提高兩成，重算銅損，再增加熱態電阻比例，分別比較兩項效應並列出現地熱量帳還缺少的損失來源。~Increase current by twenty percent at fixed resistance and recalculate copper loss. Then increase hot resistance, compare both effects separately and list the remaining loss sources required by a field heat account.

units.anchor: 軸承油熱容量~Bearing oil thermal storage
units.title: 軸承油熱容量~Bearing oil thermal storage
units.mechanism: 潤滑油除了傳熱也暫存熱量，因此負載突變後的油溫會有延遲。以油量、比熱與溫升估算顯熱可幫助檢查短時能量帳，但循環中的熱交換器、軸承金屬及管路也會儲熱。單一混合槽模型只代表平均油溫，不能推定軸瓦接觸面的最高溫度。 熱容量只改變升溫時間尺度，長時間穩態仍需足夠散熱能力，增加油量不能永久抵消持續熱負荷。~Lubricating oil transports and temporarily stores heat, producing a delayed temperature response after a load change. Oil mass, heat capacity and rise estimate sensible storage, while exchangers, bearing metal and piping also store heat. A mixed-tank model describes mean oil temperature rather than the maximum temperature at the bearing contact. Heat capacity changes the heating time scale, while long-term steady operation still needs adequate heat removal; adding oil cannot indefinitely offset a continuous thermal load.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：mOil=800 kg; cp=2000 J/(kg*K); dT=20 K; E=mOil*cp*dT/1e6=32 MJ。模型邊界：固定油量比熱的均勻溫升，不含金屬熱容量及散熱。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: mOil=800 kg; cp=2000 J/(kg*K); dT=20 K; E=mOil*cp*dT/1e6=32 MJ. Model boundary: uniform rise of a fixed oil mass with constant heat capacity, excluding metal storage and heat loss.
units.verify: 以進出口油溫、槽內多點溫度與流量檢查混合假設，將負載變化與冷卻器狀態對齊。若槽溫反應慢而軸瓦溫度迅速上升，應查局部供油與接觸熱點，不能用油槽平均溫度證明潤滑正常。~Use inlet-outlet and multiple tank temperatures with flow to test mixing, aligning load changes and cooler state. Rapid bearing-metal heating despite a slowly changing tank temperature calls for local supply and contact checks rather than declaring lubrication normal from the tank average.
units.failure: 油槽分層或旁通會使單點溫度低估高溫油區，油量不足又會縮短熱緩衝時間；如果只按穩態溫差分析，就可能漏掉短時供油中斷。~Stratification or bypass can make one tank sensor understate a hot region, while low oil inventory reduces thermal buffering time. A steady-state temperature difference alone may therefore miss a brief interruption of supply to the bearing.
units.misconception: 油槽平均溫度正常就保證軸瓦沒有熱點~Normal average oil-tank temperature guarantees no bearing hotspot.
units.practice: 在相同熱輸入下比較兩種油量的初期升溫速率，再加入金屬熱容量，說明需哪些溫度測點才能區分儲熱與散熱不足。~Compare initial heating rates for two oil inventories under equal heat input, then add metal heat capacity. Identify temperature measurements that distinguish thermal storage from inadequate heat removal in the system.

units.anchor: 谷幅變形基準~Valley closure reference geometry
units.title: 谷幅變形基準~Valley closure reference geometry
units.mechanism: 蓄水後兩岸變形會改變谷幅，但距離縮短可能來自一岸、兩岸或測量基準移動。教材把兩點間距變化除初始距離表示平均幾何應變尺度，不把它當成岩體各處的局部應變。需保留左右岸絕對位移與方向，才能把谷幅反應連結到拱座相容條件。 兩點距離只提供沿連線方向的投影，垂直於連線的共同位移可能幾乎看不到，需要完整三維控制網。~Reservoir filling can change valley width through movement of either bank, both banks or the measurement reference. Distance change divided by initial separation gives a mean geometric strain scale, not local strain everywhere in the rock. Absolute movement and direction on each side are needed to connect closure to abutment compatibility. Two-point distance supplies a projection along the line; shared movement perpendicular to it can remain almost invisible, requiring a complete three-dimensional control network.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：closure=0.012 m; width=500 m; e=closure/width*1e6=24 microstrain。模型邊界：正值表示兩點距離縮短的平均尺度，不代表均勻岩體應變。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: closure=0.012 m; width=500 m; e=closure/width*1e6=24 microstrain. Model boundary: positive value denotes a mean two-point closure scale, not uniform rock strain.
units.verify: 以外部穩定控制網分別追蹤兩岸點位，校正大氣折射與距離儀溫度，再比對庫水位及地下水變化。若谷幅縮短但單側位移占多數，模型應保留不對稱，不把一半變形平均分配給兩岸。~Track both banks against an external stable network, correcting atmospheric refraction and instrument temperature, then compare reservoir and groundwater changes. Closure dominated by one bank requires an asymmetric model rather than allocating half the measured distance change to each side by assumption.
units.failure: 共同基準位移可能不改變谷幅卻改變整體位置，單純距離量測因而漏掉剛體運動；大氣折射的季節變化也可能偽裝成與庫水位相關的地形變形。~Shared reference motion can change absolute position without changing width, so distance alone misses rigid-body movement. Seasonal atmospheric refraction can also imitate terrain deformation correlated with reservoir level unless corrected through an independent control and observation strategy.
units.misconception: 谷幅縮短必定由左右岸平均分擔~Valley closure is always shared equally by the two banks.
units.practice: 製作相同谷幅變化但左右岸位移分配不同的兩個情境，畫位移向量，說明對拱座相容的影響，以及需哪些外部控制點才能辨識。~Create two cases with equal closure but different bank displacement shares. Draw their vectors, explain effects on abutment compatibility and identify external controls needed to distinguish the cases.

units.anchor: 裂隙開度與滲流~Fracture aperture and flow
units.title: 裂隙開度與滲流~Fracture aperture and flow
units.mechanism: 理想平行板裂隙的層流導水能力與開度三次方成正比，因此很小的開度變化也可能明顯改變流量。教材使用光滑固定開度及牛頓流體，將壓差、黏度與流路長度列明；天然裂隙粗糙、接觸及網絡分岔會改變此關係，不能用流量唯一反推幾何。 流路長度與開度可能互相補償產生相同流量，反算參數具有非唯一性，需要獨立幾何或示蹤資料縮小範圍。~Laminar conductance of an ideal parallel-plate fracture varies with aperture cubed, making small opening changes important. State smooth fixed aperture, Newtonian viscosity, pressure difference and path length. Roughness, contacts and network branching alter natural fractures, so measured flow does not uniquely determine the physical aperture of a real seepage path. Path length and aperture can compensate to produce the same flow, making inverse estimates nonunique; independent geometry or tracer evidence is needed to constrain them.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：b=1 m; a=0.0002 m; dp=1000000 Pa; mu=0.001 Pa*s; L=10 m; Q=b*a**3*dp/(12*mu*L)=0.00006666666667 m3/s。模型邊界：光滑平行板穩態層流且開度固定，不含裂隙網絡與紊流。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: b=1 m; a=0.0002 m; dp=1000000 Pa; mu=0.001 Pa*s; L=10 m; Q=b*a**3*dp/(12*mu*L)=0.00006666666667 m3/s. Model boundary: steady laminar flow between smooth parallel plates at fixed aperture, excluding networks and turbulence.
units.verify: 在受控壓差下量測流量與溫度以修正黏度，重複升降壓檢查開度是否隨壓力改變。若流量與壓差非線性，應先辨識變形或流況，不直接以三次方律推算裂縫已增加多少。~Measure flow and temperature under controlled pressure difference to account for viscosity, repeating pressure increase and decrease to test aperture stability. Nonlinearity requires investigating deformation or flow regime before using the cubic law to claim a particular increase in physical crack opening.
units.failure: 接觸點閉合與局部堵塞會使有效水力開度不同於量得的平均幾何開度；若溫度變化降低黏度，流量也會增加，不能把所有增流都認定為裂隙擴張。~Contact closure and local blockage make hydraulic aperture differ from mean geometric aperture. Warming can also lower viscosity and increase flow, so every rise in seepage cannot be assigned to fracture enlargement without temperature and pressure evidence.
units.misconception: 滲流量增加就唯一證明裂隙開度增加~An increase in seepage uniquely proves an increase in fracture aperture.
units.practice: 將開度提高兩成重算流量，再只降低黏度作比較，展示兩種增流原因，並設計能區分幾何變化與流體性質變化的量測組合。~Increase aperture by twenty percent and recompute flow, then compare a change in viscosity alone. Show the two causes of increased discharge and design measurements that distinguish geometry from fluid-property changes.

units.anchor: 通風局部阻力~Ventilation local resistance
units.title: 通風局部阻力~Ventilation local resistance
units.mechanism: 地下廠房及廊道通風包含彎頭、格柵和分支等局部阻力，壓損與動壓及阻力係數相關。教材以一個已知係數估算局部壓損，提醒學員係數的參考速度必須明確。這只是正常通風能量帳，不代表火災煙控、逃生條件或所有分支風量均已驗證。 阻力係數使用的參考速度可能位於不同斷面，串接多構件時應換成一致能量帳，不能直接加不相容的係數。~Underground powerhouse ventilation includes local losses at bends, screens and branches, related to dynamic pressure and a loss coefficient. One assumed coefficient estimates local pressure loss, with its reference velocity explicitly stated. This normal-ventilation account does not verify smoke control, escape conditions or flow distribution through every branch of the network. Loss coefficients may use velocities at different sections; connecting several fittings requires a consistent energy account rather than directly adding coefficients with incompatible reference velocities.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：K=2.5 (dimensionless); rho=1.2 kg/m3; v=12 m/s; dp=K*0.5*rho*v*v=216 Pa。模型邊界：穩態不可壓縮近似及已指定參考斷面速度，未含沿程阻力。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: K=2.5 (dimensionless); rho=1.2 kg/m3; v=12 m/s; dp=K*0.5*rho*v*v=216 Pa. Model boundary: steady approximately incompressible air with a specified reference-section velocity, excluding distributed friction.
units.verify: 在構件前後設壓力測點，避開強烈旋流區並量測截面速度分布，再核對所用係數的參考面積。若多個支路同時調整，須重算風網，不能把一支路壓損直接當整個風機所需壓升。~Measure pressure before and after the fitting away from strong swirl, map section velocity and verify the coefficient reference area. Simultaneous branch changes require a network recalculation; one branch loss cannot simply be treated as the pressure rise required from the entire fan system.
units.failure: 格柵堵塞或風門位置偏差會改變係數，舊調試值未必適用；若壓力測點位於回流區，也可能產生非代表讀值，導致錯判風機能力不足。~A blocked screen or changed damper position alters the coefficient and can invalidate commissioning values. A tap inside a recirculation zone can also give an unrepresentative reading and falsely suggest inadequate fan capability in the ventilation network.
units.misconception: 單一構件壓損就是整座風機所需壓升~The loss across one fitting equals the pressure rise required for the whole fan system.
units.practice: 固定風道面積提高風量兩成，重算局部壓損，再加入一個並聯支路，說明為何分支流量必須由共同壓差及各自阻力一起求解。~Increase flow by twenty percent at fixed duct area and recalculate local loss. Add a parallel branch and explain why branch flows must be solved from the shared pressure difference and their individual resistances.

units.anchor: 梯級重複用水發電~Cascade reuse of release water
units.title: 梯級重複用水發電~Cascade reuse of release water
units.mechanism: 同一水量通過上下游兩座電站，可利用兩段不同的落差，並非創造新的水量或把同一位能重複計算。教材以同一流量乘各段淨水頭效率相加求總功率，先確認兩段高程落差不重疊。實際河道傳播、支流與水庫儲存會使兩站瞬時流量不同。 上下游兩段效率各自作用於各段位能，不應把效率連乘套在總落差，因第一段損失不會消滅下游全部落差。~The same water can generate through two successive drops without creating water or counting one potential-energy drop twice. Sum each net-head and efficiency contribution at a common assumed discharge, confirming that the elevation intervals do not overlap. Routing, tributaries and storage can make actual instantaneous discharges differ between plants. Each efficiency acts on its own potential-energy drop; multiplying efficiencies over total head misrepresents the stages, because losses upstream do not eliminate the downstream drop.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=500 m3/s; H1=90 m; eta1=0.91 (dimensionless); H2=70 m; eta2=0.90 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*(H1*eta1+H2*eta2)/1e6=710.7345 MW。模型邊界：相同穩態流量與不重疊淨水頭，忽略中間取水及儲量變化。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=500 m3/s; H1=90 m; eta1=0.91 (dimensionless); H2=70 m; eta2=0.90 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*(H1*eta1+H2*eta2)/1e6=710.7345 MW. Model boundary: equal steady flow through nonoverlapping net heads, omitting intermediate withdrawals and storage changes.
units.verify: 以河段高程圖標明兩段淨水頭及尾水控制，再核對上下游流量時間對齊與中間儲量。若同時流量不同，先做河段水量帳與傳播分析，不把差值直接列為漏水或發電效率損失。~Mark both net heads and tailwater controls on an elevation profile and reconcile flow timing and intermediate storage. Different simultaneous discharges require reach water accounting and routing before the difference is labeled leakage or a generating-efficiency loss between the two plants.
units.failure: 將上游總落差再次列入下游水頭會重複計算位能，忽略流量延遲又會使逐時能量帳不閉合；兩者可能在月平均下被掩蓋，需保留分段基準。~Including the upstream drop again in downstream head double-counts potential energy. Ignoring travel delay also disrupts hourly energy closure. Monthly averages can conceal both errors, so elevation references and interval boundaries must be retained for each stage.
units.misconception: 同一水量二次發電就是重複創造水的位能~Generating twice with the same water creates the same potential energy twice.
units.practice: 將總落差固定而改變兩站分配及效率，計算總功率差，再加入一段中間取水，說明何時相同流量假設失效及應如何修正。~Hold total drop fixed while changing its allocation and the two efficiencies, then calculate total power. Introduce an intermediate withdrawal and explain when the equal-flow assumption fails and how the account must change.

units.anchor: 增流邊際功率~Marginal power from added flow
units.title: 增流邊際功率~Marginal power from added flow
units.mechanism: 增加機組流量會提高水力輸入，也可能增加與流量平方相關的引水損失，因此每增加一單位流量得到的功率不是固定值。教材對含損失的功率式微分，區分平均功率除流量與邊際增益。這個局部分析仍需效率及運轉區域限制，不能作無約束最佳化命令。 損失項隨流量平方增加，功率中的該項則隨流量三次方，因此微分後會出現三倍係數，不能漏算。~Increasing turbine flow raises hydraulic input while also increasing conveyance losses that may scale with flow squared. Marginal power is therefore not constant. Differentiate a loss-inclusive power equation and distinguish its derivative from average power divided by discharge. Efficiency variation and operating-region limits remain necessary before any optimization interpretation. Head loss grows with flow squared, but its contribution within power grows with flow cubed; differentiation therefore introduces a factor of three that must be retained.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; eta=0.9 (dimensionless); Hs=100 m; k=0.00002 s2/m5; Q=300 m3/s; dPdQ=rho*g*eta*(Hs-3*k*Q*Q)/1e6=0.8352234 MW/(m3/s)。模型邊界：淨水頭Hs-kQ²且效率固定的局部導數，未含尾水非線性及機組限制。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; eta=0.9 (dimensionless); Hs=100 m; k=0.00002 s2/m5; Q=300 m3/s; dPdQ=rho*g*eta*(Hs-3*k*Q*Q)/1e6=0.8352234 MW/(m3/s). Model boundary: local derivative for net head Hs-kQ² at constant efficiency, excluding nonlinear tailwater and machine limits.
units.verify: 以小幅流量增量重算原功率式，用有限差分檢查導數，再以量測曲線驗證損失係數在該區間是否近似固定。若大增量與局部預測不同，應縮小區間或更新模型，不把導數當成全域線性關係。~Recompute the original power equation with a small flow increment and compare its finite difference with the derivative. Verify approximately constant loss coefficient over that interval. A large-increment disagreement calls for a smaller interval or revised model rather than treating a local derivative as a global linear law.
units.failure: 忽略損失導數會高估增流收益，效率若在高流量區下降則偏差更大；把局部最大功率當成允許運轉點，也可能越過汽蝕、振動或電氣限制。~Ignoring the derivative of head loss overstates added-flow benefit, especially if efficiency falls at higher discharge. A mathematical power maximum may also lie beyond cavitation, vibration or electrical limits and does not establish an authorized operating point.
units.misconception: 平均功率除流量必定等於增流邊際功率~Average power divided by flow always equals marginal power from added flow.
units.practice: 以一個很小及一個較大流量增量比較有限差分與導數，畫出誤差隨步長變化，再加入效率下降情境指出原導數缺少的項目。~Compare finite differences using a small and a larger flow increment with the derivative, plot error against step size, and introduce declining efficiency to identify the additional derivative term missing from the original model.
